name: Open-Faced Hot Roast Beef Sandwich with Brown Gravy
whyItWorks: Tender, slow-roasted beef sliced over soft white bread and topped with warm savory gravy and smooth mashed potatoes provides low-fiber, gentle, comforting nourishment that is easy on the GI tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for smooth peeled mashed potatoes without skin. Request gravy lightly ladled on top.
